name: Hive 1.9.0
notes: A modern UI pass. The new Refined look replaces tinted turn cards with flat, hairline-separated turns, carried through the shared cards, the right rail, and the workflow views. New Obsidian theme — a true dark, monochrome near-black glass with a silver accent that stays dark in both Light and Dark modes; the old cool-blue 'midnight' is renamed 'slate'. Workflows gain iterate-until-good loops: a review gate can route back to an earlier stage so you can cycle fix → recheck until you approve, and @hive can author these loops when you ask. Docs now cover every Settings section — Detect/Test/Add-model and portable hive.toml, the relay issuer key, a Diagnostics section, the searchable nav, and the People-pane remote-agent generator.
